config.source_classification: Actual recovered queued user input; source defaults remain uncalibrated, not certified production measurements
config.duration_policy: Keep both complete original layers, targets, rates, phases, source/mask geometry; no truncation or duration substitution

sensitivity_probe.status: Synthetic fixed sensitivity probe, not an optimized candidate or empirical uncertainty

convergence.definition: Tolerance is10% of the normalized area-weighted RMS field difference between the complete-process baseline and the fixed10-mm sensitivity probe at direct .025s, grid21. Check CV changes and normalized field differences against this scale; no arbitrary absolute percent target and no rigorous error-bound claim.
convergence.requirements: Direct-vs-finite-periodic agreement must pass before using periodic for full-process grid/source convergence. Time, grid and source must pass separately; use a fully covered inset ROI alongside changing full-disk cell coverage. No fresh optimizer or ranking until these gates pass.

config.periodic_policy: Use existing finite_periodic decomposition including all whole cycles and real-phase residuals; do not use fast_cycle approximation that omits layer tails

decisions.reason: Time or periodic agreement exceeds effect-relative tolerance

decisions.action: Do not use periodic acceleration for spatial/source certification
decisions.reason: Whole direct agreement not established at bounded finest step
